summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS09: 15 market actors recorded (7 competitors, 2 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R3-specialists.md, R5-research-os.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- Prime Intellect Lab [competitor]: Environments Hub, verifiers, hosted agentic RL Gap/note: public evaluation/environment registry Traction: public beta (https://docs.primeintellect.ai/hosted-training/what-is-lab). Licence: open-source verifiers; hosted service. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Kiln [alternative]: Desktop workbench for evals, synthetic data, fine-tuning, auto-optimize Gap/note: eval builder Traction: 5.2k stars (https://github.com/Kiln-AI/Kiln). Licence: MIT library; source-available app. Checked 2026-10-09.
- SkillOpt / SkillOpt-Sleep [competitor]: Held-out-gated skill optimization; nightly mining of recurring tasks from coding-agent transcripts Gap/note: optimized skill artifacts Traction: 18.2k stars (https://github.com/microsoft/SkillOpt). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hermes Agent [competitor]: Self-improving agent creating skills from experience; trajectory generation Gap/note: community skill libraries Traction: 252k stars (https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Braintrust [competitor]: Eval/observability with Topics clustering, Patterns and Loop Gap/note: eval datasets/scorers Traction: $80M Series B at $800M (Feb 2026) (https://www.axios.com/pro/enterprise-software-deals/2026/02/17/ai-observability-braintrust-80-million-800-million). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Langfuse [partner]: Open-source tracing, datasets, experiments; ClickHouse-owned Gap/note: trace/dataset source Traction: 35.6k stars (https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse). Licence: MIT (except ee). Checked 2026-10-09.
- HoneyHive [alternative]: Agent observability and regression datasets Gap/note: eval datasets Traction: $7.4M total (https://www.vcaonline.com/news/2025040812/honeyhive-a-leadingai-agent-observability-and-evaluation-platform-announces-launch-and-7-4m-in-total-funding-led-by-insight-partners/). Licence: commercial. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Humanloop [benchmark]: Prompt/eval platform shut down after Anthropic acquisition Gap/note: exit Traction: sunset 2025-09-08 (https://wandb.ai/wandb_fc/product-announcements-fc/reports/Humanloop-is-sunsetting-Migrate-to-Weights-Biases-as-an-alternative--VmlldzoxMzk4ODc1Nw). Licence: proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- evo (evo-hq) [competitor]: Codebase autoresearch plugin: metric discovery, tree search with parallel subagents, gates, shared failure traces Gap/note: Gates incl. held-out score floor Traction: 1.5k stars; commercial platform in beta (https://github.com/evo-hq/evo). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- MLEvolve [benchmark]: Monte Carlo Graph Search MLE agent with global success/failure-labelled experience memory Gap/note: MLE-bench reference Traction: 448 stars; MLE-bench 61.3% (leaderboard), 65.3% self-reported (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- MLE-bench (OpenAI) [benchmark]: 75-competition Kaggle benchmark for ML engineering agents Gap/note: Known leakage issues documented Traction: 1.8k stars; top any-medal 64.4%; submissions paused (https://github.com/openai/mle-bench). Licence: See LICENSE file (type not shown). Checked 2026-10-09.
- autocontext (greyhaven-ai) [competitor]: Recursive self-improving harness with playbooks, gated promotion, model routing, distillation Gap/note: False-promotion budget and confirmation gates Traction: 1.3k stars (https://github.com/greyhaven-ai/autocontext). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- CORAL [partner]: Multi-agent autoresearch with shared notes/skills and grader isolation Gap/note: Grader isolation pattern Traction: 1.1k stars; COLM 2026 (https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/CORAL). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- MLflow 3 [partner]: Open AI engineering platform with tracking, GenAI evaluation, MCP server Gap/note: Judges and eval datasets Traction: 28.3k stars (https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Comet Opik [competitor]: LLM tracing/evaluation with Agent Optimizer SDK and MCP server Gap/note: Evaluation plus optimisation Traction: 22.5k stars (https://github.com/comet-ml/opik). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
